data.status: 14 new restaurants planned; 51 renovations planned across Quebec

The majority of funding comes from Canadian franchise owners, with Tim Hortons corporate contributing an additional $130 million CAD.

The African-inspired full-service restaurant serves breakfast, lunch, and dinner including jollof rice, suya, and grilled meats. The location evolved from the brand's ghost kitchen concept launched in 2025.

The brand aims to elevate rum's perception and appeal to consumers who typically favor tequila or other spirits.

Ted's Hot Dogs will open its newest Chandler location on May 23, 2026, featuring a retro-inspired design and the brand's first-ever drive-thru. The grand opening celebration includes giveaways, free ice cream, and Buffalo-themed festivities running over two days. Founded in Buffalo, New York in 1927, the fourth-generation chain is known for charcoal-grilled hot dogs and open-fire cooking.

Ristobar, a 22-year-old Italian restaurant in San Francisco's Marina District, is closing on Memorial Day, May 25, 2026. The restaurant team thanked the community and noted the Chestnut Street space will continue in a new direction as Eria Marina, a 5,300 sq. ft. indoor-outdoor events venue through a partnership with Eria Events.
